meaning:
μολυσμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(μολύνω), [in LXX: Jer.23:15 (חֲנֻפָה), I Est.8:83, 2Ma.5:27 * ;]
defilement: with genitive obj., 2Co.7:1 (Plut., FlJ).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
